question: Which of the following statements is correct?
solution: Line \(AB\) and line \(BA\) represent the same line; line segments \(AB\) and \(BA\) are the same segment; rays \(AB\) and \(BA\) have different endpoints and are not the same ray; the length of a line cannot be measured.
